## One important thing I deliberately changed

I would **not** tell Claude to blindly use every 21st.dev/shadcn component it can find. That usually creates the exact problem you're trying to avoid: a website that looks like a collection of component demos.

Instead, the prompt tells it to use **21st.dev + shadcn/ui as the component foundation**, while maintaining **one coherent custom design system**.
